mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% month-over-month signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 2% year-over-year signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong economic growth and labor market tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
